summary: Implemented the registry-backed global overview metrics and project bucket grid. Live console data now reads registry list/doctor, all-work counts, sync, doctor, and reservations, and uses explicit --workspace reads for registered project roots. The global route renders project health, open/ready/blocked work, stale/sync freshness, active reservations, memory git mode, and explicit project dashboard links.
command: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm console:build && node apps/console/dist/smoke.js --workspace . --mode fixture --out .boreal/results/console-route-smoke.json && node apps/console/dist/browser-smoke.js --workspace . --mode fixture --out .boreal/results/console-browser-smoke.json && node apps/console/dist/render-file.js --workspace . --mode live --route / --out .boreal/results/console-global-live.html && git diff --check
